versions.description_html:
Discover Fabric IQ in Microsoft Fabric. Learn how ontology, semantic models, and AI grounding stop data drift and unify your organization's data meaning.

Somewhere in your Fabric workspace, two teams are calling the same customer two different things. Your data is fine, but the meaning behind it has quietly drifted apart.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • What Fabric IQ Actually Is
  • Why Data Alone Isn't Enough
  • The Ontology, Explained
  • How It Connects to Semantic Models
  • How It Grounds AI Agents
  • Where It Stops
  • What This Means For You
  • Recap and One Question

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.

Explore more on M365.FM
  • Full episode page with transcript, key takeaways and FAQ
  • From Financial Data to AI-Ready Decisions: Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Semantic Models & AI Agents with Rishi Sapra [MVP]
  • Microsoft Fabric End-to-End: From Raw Data to Business Decisions with Amit Chandak [MVP]
  • More Data & Fabric episodes on M365.FM
  • Best of Data & Fabric: the most-listened episodes
